Name: Projectile Self Hit Options / 子彈能擊中自己 選單
Description:
Puts the scope of local.p11-self-hit-fast in game under ESC > MODS (Mod Options Menu). Needs Bingus Shared Loader, Mod Options Menu and the code mod enabled. Applies at once on APPLY.
把 local.p11-self-hit-fast 的生效範圍放進遊戲內 ESC > MODS（Mod Options Menu）。需要 Bingus Shared Loader、Mod Options Menu 與本體 code mod 都啟用。按 APPLY 立即生效。
